title: Karachi Police Officer Suspended Following Audio Leak
excerpt: A police station house officer in Karachi has been suspended after an audio recording allegedly captured him apologizing to a drug dealer.
body_html:
A police station house officer (SHO) in Karachi has faced suspension following the emergence of an audio recording.

According to reports, the leaked audio allegedly features the law enforcement official apologizing to a drug dealer. Authorities took action after the recording surfaced, leading to the officer's suspension.
